_readme: Everything about the submission that is still undecided lives here. Change any value; make_submission.py reads it fresh every run. Placeholders in a command: {python} = the interpreter running make_submission.py, {workdir} = an empty scratch folder for this run.

hmm.description: hmm_v9: sticky HMM, tracking clues + control classifier + two players-only nets, Viterbi per half, restart and keeper holds (hmm/decode.py). Python 3.11, needs torch

hmm_v8.description: Fallback without torch: hmm_v9 minus the nets (hmm.decode --no-net)

alldata.description: The previous submission (2026-11-16 to 2026-11-17): learned all-data model with Tim's v8 as input and touch evidence (alldata/learned/run.py). Superseded by hmm_v9; kept buildable

baseline.description: Organisers' nearest-player baseline, +/-125 frame vote. Only for testing this pipeline end to end.
